title: Restricted decision tree depth
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment on the coordinates outside $J$. Define the restricted decision tree depth to be the decision tree depth of the binary function obtained by restricting $f$ according to these choices.
